risk_summary: The excerpt combines quantified cash-use and funding data with extensive promotional, largely unverified claims about platform capabilities, audience scale, efficiency, and conversion benefits. Liquidity risk appears material, given recurring cash requirements of $100,000–$200,000 per month, reliance on private investors and convertible-note financing, and an apparent going-concern qualification. The discussion is highly technical and marketing-oriented, with substantial reliance on estimates, future execution, and non-binding funding indications.
